question: In which Northeast Indian state is the Indian Institute of Corporate Affairs (IICA) establishing its first regional campus?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Meghalaya.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **IICA acquired a five-acre land parcel in New Shillong Township, Meghalaya, to establish its first-ever regional campus in Northeast India.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **Location:** The regional campus is being established in Shillong, Meghalaya, within the Knowledge City cluster.
 
• **Investment:** The project is backed by a ₹100.95 crore investment under the Prime Minister’s Development Initiative for Northeast (PM-DevINE).
 
• **Focus Areas:** The campus will focus on corporate governance, ESG, CSR, insolvency, competition law, and board leadership training and research.
 
• **Regional Development:** The campus aims to support entrepreneurship, capacity building, and good governance aligned with national priorities and the PM’s vision for Northeast India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **Indian Institute of Corporate Affairs (IICA):** A government institute under the Ministry of Corporate Affairs focused on corporate governance and policy research.
 
• **PM-DevINE:** The Prime Minister’s Development Initiative for Northeast, aimed at boosting economic growth and infrastructure in the region.
 
• **Knowledge City Cluster:** The area in Shillong that hosts prominent institutions such as IIM Shillong and National Law University Meghalaya.
 
• **Cooperative Federalism:** The partnership between the Centre and Meghalaya government exemplifies India’s cooperative federalism model to promote regional growth.
